name: securenow/securenow
description: SecureNow for PHP: traces, logs, request capture with redaction, and an in-app firewall (blocklist, allowlist, rate limits, challenges, scraper blocking, session revocation) for Laravel, Symfony, Slim, WordPress and plain PHP.

suggest.ext-curl: Faster, parallel export of telemetry (falls back to PHP streams without it).
suggest.ext-apcu: Shared in-memory firewall state and rate-limit counters across PHP-FPM workers.
suggest.ext-opentelemetry: Zero-code spans for frameworks, databases and HTTP clients (OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation).
suggest.open-telemetry/sdk: Required with ext-opentelemetry so OpenTelemetry spans are exported through SecureNow.
